reviewMethod: Static native and enlarged contact sheets, adjacent key/in-between/key triples, source provenance and pixel comparison. Animated playback not independently observed.

findings.observation: New pose is 190px tall, below both neighbouring approved poses (199/193px). The 3px additional undershoot remains. The shortened stride still visually approaches the next contact pose too early; arm swing and leg phase are not accepted as an even progression.

Near-arm position is more intermediate, but the new pose is 189px tall against neighbouring 193/194px poses: 4px additional undershoot. The body appears smaller/lower. Support-leg continuity is not approved solely from file order or matching baseline.

limitations: Baseline consistency does not prove stable head position, scale, identity or gait.
Approved keys themselves retain their original 6px height range; they were not re-scaled or repainted.
Frames 2 and 8 pass the height-range check, not a substitute for full motion or user approval.
No independent per-frame scale fitting, duplicate frames or faster timing used to hide failed drawings.
No automatic derivation of left walk and no runtime asset replacement.
